purpose: Evaluate wait-for-all round messages and a PROG-only alternative for accumulating admission/certification lag.
result: The full barrier removed drift but held ready certificates. PROG-only pacing with immediate bundling removed measured drift while keeping approximately 33 ms proposal-to-commit latency.

settings.delay_method: Opaque pipelined userspace TCP chunk proxy, minimum requested delay per direction; actual scheduling adds delay.

unchanged: 7Delta main timer and 3Delta catch-up timer constants/guards
changed: full-barrier mode also delays already-enabled positive messages until readiness/deadline/recovery hint
protocol_scope.full_barrier_recovery: Authenticated CLOSED hints release pending and future barriers through h+1. Held own CLOSED is not counted until emission. A Byzantine signer can disable this pacing via a distant authenticated hint, without inventing quorum evidence.
protocol_scope.progress_only: Only origin PROG waits for a valid proposal at k-1 or k, or its finite entry deadline. Amplification and positive messages stay prompt. No CLOSED scheduling hint.
protocol_scope.proof_scope: Original latency theorem is not automatically inherited: same-round proposal release can add one delay unless PROG was already released by proposal broadcast.

limits: Each final same-binary, tracing-disabled mode has one 60-second measurement; this is local evidence, not indefinite stability or WAN capacity.

Transaction latency is origin insertion before signed production to post-handler materialization, weighted over transactions completed in the window. Pending transactions are excluded; later drain does not change this population.
Round-level stage means use their stated common cohorts and must not be added to transaction-weighted latency.
Traced canonical/full-barrier and batch/PROG-only runs use two successive builds, so they are diagnostic observations, not an identical-binary four-way ablation.
Stride-128 canonical control stayed near 77 ms, showing sensitivity to tracing and host scheduling. All controls are retained.
Traffic is successful replica TCP-stream writes including framing/authentication/ACKs, excluding TCP/IP and proxy duplicate writes.
No Raptr/Mysticeti rerun or cross-protocol ranking is claimed.

comparison.latency_endpoint: local producer insertion immediately before signed batch production to post-handler local materialization; completed-in-window population

control_epochs.note: Interior epoch boundaries use the nearest recorded controller snapshot; native measurement start/end are exact. Actual boundary times are retained. Epoch latencies use cumulative origin-local counters, never trace-based round averages.

round_barriers.note: Held duration is from ordering_held to the matching first ordering_outbox, with outbox in native window. Kind+round identifies the local once-only message; no packet-sequence joins. PROG origin is created at release and has no held-message trace, so its barrier wait is not in these durations.
